name: perf-player-gameplay
purpose: iter-465 perf lane (tools/perf/perf_run.py --scenario gameplay): the player's path WITHOUT the MODS restart (player_wholerun.json's child half): boot -> intro movies -> title -> custom MAIN MENU -> NEW GAME (cursor click) -> the opening FMV -> the tutorial in Metropolis with the HUD, then a long gameplay window (tools/player/gameplay_play.txt drives keyboard + mouse-look through the harness channel). Only milestone lines are awaited, so it also runs under SR_LOG=player. Run with SR_PORT_FEATURES=1 for the player's configuration (natural=false).

steps.name: title-settle
steps.purpose: The title era (fps sample) before START.

steps.name: menu-settle
steps.purpose: The MAIN MENU era fps sample (no mouse: the focus stays on NEW GAME, row 0).

steps.name: new-game
steps.purpose: ENTER (= A) on NEW GAME (the default focus, row 0).

steps.name: skip-opening-movie
steps.purpose: iter-467 cutscene skip (owner 2026-10-11: a natural player action, not forcing; sr_drive -SkipCutscenes / SR_DRIVE_SKIP_CUTSCENES=0 turns it off): A pulses during the new game's opening FMV (the skip-movie action, event 187: A (alt) / START in the gameplay contexts, docs/PC_CONTROLS.md) until the movie is over: the player's first gameplay MODE ([PC_CONTROLS] context gameplay ... mode on-foot camera; the merge-ready gate showed pad A killing the opening FMV with NO [EV187] accept line), an [EV187] ... ACCEPTED-KILL edge, or the movie's own EOM if it ends first. The gate's in-game start takes either (tools/perf/perf_report.py MOVIE_SKIP). Optional: a missed skip only costs the movie's 30 s.
steps.expect: \[EV187\] #\d+ slot=\d+ rc=01 ACCEPTED-KILL|\[MOVIE_PACE\] movie#\d+ EOM wall=[\d.]+s frames=(?:[2-9]|[1-9]\d+)\b|\[PC_CONTROLS\] context gameplay \(igc type \d+\) config \S+ invX=\d+ invY=\d+ mode [a-z]

steps.name: gameplay
steps.purpose: Gameplay window (the tutorial): gameplay_play.txt walks, looks, takes off and flies meanwhile.
